name: BSP_LeaderboardsScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this) returning this, SEH frame, RET. The 16Ch screen at 00E198AC+6Ch. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Construct (004F7180), installs primary vtable 00CEE9CC at +00h and 00CEE9B8 at +08h, 00CEE998 at +0Ch, zeroes +14h..+1Ch and calls 00683610 twice; the rest of the 16Ch is left to the register override. Slot +00h of 00CEE9CC is 005633F0, a 'mov eax,0Ah; ret' leaf, so the screen id is 0Ah = INTF_LEADERBOARDS. The vtable is followed by the keys Columns, TableDesc, ColumnName, LBoards, LB_UniqueID and Leaderboards. Register override 00564220 binds the list and scroll widgets; enter 00562750 sets FE.main_leaderboards_title. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_LeaderboardsScreen_GetScreenId
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Five bytes: 'mov eax,0Ah; ret'. Slot +00h of vtable 00CEE9CC, the registry index 004F71D0 uses. 0Ah is INTF_LEADERBOARDS in the 00E08CD8 table, which agrees with the class's Leaderboards and LB_UniqueID keys. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_MultiSessionBrowserScreen_Register
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this), primary vtable slot +10h of 00CEF134. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register (004F71D0) and builds the browser's widget and texture bindings: it references globals.no_server_found and composes gui/radarshots/ paths with the suffixes _C.tga, _D.tga, _E.tga, _S.tga, _ICS.tga, _ICM.tga, _ICL.tga and _ICH.tga through BSP_NativeString_Concat and BSP_NativeString_Substring. Body past the registration was not read. docs/MULTI_MENU_SCREENS.md
